blocks.content: IK Labs — software, agents and data to operate better
We are not a traditional software factory; we are agentic and AI-first. We design, build and deploy enterprise software, intelligent agents and conversational data solutions.

We combine accelerated development, automation, artificial intelligence, data architecture and business expertise to deliver functional, measurable and sustainable solutions. We turn complex processes into real digital capabilities.
We build intelligent technology so organizations can operate better, decide faster and reduce manual work.
We develop technology in less time, without relying on long traditional development cycles.
These are not generic chatbots. Each agent retrieves information, responds, generates reports, runs workflows, escalates to humans and keeps a traceable record of its activity.
No more digging through scattered reports. Users ask and the agent answers from connected sources, in text, tables, summaries, visualizations, alerts or executive reports.
Three clear stages, from launch to continuous evolution.
Your investment combines a project-based launch with monthly support: immediate value and continuous evolution.
Let's talk about your challenge and design the agent or solution your organization needs.
The professional, creative and innovative technology partner for public-sector transparency.
